# Trinka

> > Trinka is an AI-powered writing and grammar checker platform designed for academic and technical writing, offering comprehensive tools for grammar correction, plagiarism detection, citation management, and content generation.

Trinka provides a complete writing assistance ecosystem with support for multiple style guides (APA, AMA, ACS), available across cloud, desktop, and browser platforms. The platform serves academic institutions, publishers, and enterprises with features ranging from basic grammar checking to advanced plagiarism detection and journal recommendations.

## Key Topics

- Grammar checker
- Plagiarism detection
- Academic writing
- Citation formatter
- AI writing assistant
- MS Word integration
- Style guides (APA, AMA, ACS)
- Cloud-based editing
- Browser plugin
- Windows desktop app
- Enterprise solution
- Offline processing
- Technical writing
- Document editing
- Data privacy

## Core Writing Features

- [Trinka: AI Writing and Grammar Checker Tool](https://www.trinka.ai): Trinka AI: Grammar checker & writing assistant for academic & technical writing.
- [Advanced Grammar Checker](https://www.trinka.ai/features/grammar-checker): Advanced grammar checker with style guides (APA, AMA, ACS, AGU) support.
- [Trinka Paraphraser](https://www.trinka.ai/features/paraphraser): AI paraphrasing tool for rephrase sentences, paragraphs, and articles.
- [AI-Assisted Writing](https://www.trinka.ai/features/ai-studio/ai-assisted-writing): GenAI-powered writing assistant for content generation and writer's block.
- [Consistency Check](https://www.trinka.ai/features/consistency-check): Consistency checker for spelling, formatting, and style compliance.
- [Language Translation](https://www.trinka.ai/features/translation): Multi-language file translation for academic writing with cloud integration.

## Academic Integrity & Publication Tools

- [Plagiarism Checker](https://www.trinka.ai/features/plagiarism-check): Plagiarism detection trusted by 1700+ publishers worldwide.
- [Citation Checker](https://www.trinka.ai/features/citation-checker): Citation analysis detecting retracted papers and predatory journals.
- [Citation Formatter](https://www.trinka.ai/features/citation-formatter): Citation formatter supporting MLA, APA, AMA, ACS, and Elsevier styles.
- [Journal Finder](https://www.trinka.ai/features/journal-finder): Journal recommendation engine matching papers to publication venues.
- [AI Content Detector](https://www.trinka.ai/features/ai-content-detector): AI content detector for ChatGPT, Gemini, and other GenAI tools.

## Platforms & Applications

- [Trinka Cloud Editor](https://www.trinka.ai/trinkacloud): Cloud-based grammar editor with real-time corrections and file uploads.
- [Windows Desktop App](https://www.trinka.ai/windows-desktop-app): Windows desktop application with offline grammar checking capability.
- [Offline Grammar Checker](https://www.trinka.ai/windows-desktop-app/offline-grammar-checker): Offline grammar checker for Windows with no internet dependency.
- [Browser Plugin](https://www.trinka.ai/browser-plugin): Browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, Edge with Google Docs support.
- [MS Word Plugin](https://www.trinka.ai/wordplugin): Windows desktop app for grammar checking in MS Word and Outlook.
- [Proofread Files](https://www.trinka.ai/features/proofread-file): MS Word file proofreading with tracked changes and cloud storage support.

## Enterprise & API Solutions

- [Grammar Checker API](https://www.trinka.ai/enterprise/grammar-checker-api): Grammar checker API for real-time and passive text checking integration.
- [On-Premise Grammar Checker](https://www.trinka.ai/enterprise/on-premise-grammar-checker): Enterprise on-premise solution with data security and customization.
